items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: we used to Bix and I used to laugh about one personal tragedy that we each we shared

ctx.x: this is from people who said well this is the way he would play jazz piano not his own compositions which are more formalized but that his middle finger was active feeling out fourths and fifths and so forth

we used to Bix and I used to laugh about one personal tragedy that we each we shared and that is that some pianos sound always as if they're using the loud pedal the sustaining pedal well they are not it's a question of touch entirely and the piano is an awful funny Rube Goldberg instrument anyhow with mallets and levers and springs and things and why this happens I don't know but Bix and I both sounded and always have sounded as if we had the loud pedal on neither of us ever touch it
his records don't sound too much that way but he can play a very good piano
